jobs.title: Mixed Signal Analog Circuit Designer (RDSS Intern)
jobs.description:
***By submitting your resume, you’re expressing interest in our 2027 RDSS (Research and Development Substitute Services) program. Please confirm your eligibility with the local district office before applying the role.***

  

We are looking for a Mixed-Signal / Analog Circuit Designer – someone who is excited to join a growing group of diverse individuals responsible for handling challenging high-speed mixed-signal circuit designs. NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself over two decades. Our invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern AI — the next era of computing. NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can pursue, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work, to amplify human creativity and intelligence.

  

**What you'll be doing:**

* Be part of an analog team developing high-speed chip interfaces and complex analog functions that enable our graphics processing units (GPU) and SoC products (Tegra)
* Design state-of-the-art mixed-signal circuits in deep sub-micron CMOS technologies.
* Work closely with physical/layout engineers to floorplan and implement physical design of these functions.
* Support debug, characterization and support product through high-volume production.
If you have the dream to learn and explore new technologies and have good analytical skills, this is the ideal position for you.  

  

**What we need to see:**

* You have a MSEE or PhD in Electrical Engineering.
* Proven understanding of analog circuit layout concepts in submicron CMOS technologies
* You have interests in more than one of the following areas: digital links for display interfaces (such as HDMI, LVDS, DVI, MIPI PHY, Display Port), USB, low-jitter clock synthesis using PLL techniques, IO pads, high-speed serial links, and ADC.

* 區域與業務管理: 有效管理所屬區域及 HP／GP 客戶，依市場與客戶特性制定並執行區域計畫，深化重點客戶及通路經營；持續掌握市場契機，積極開發新客戶、新病患來源及新商機，推動區域業務成長。
* 客戶經營: 依客戶分級與目標設定制定拜訪計畫，建立並維持良好的重點客戶關係，運用專業銷售技巧了解並滿足客戶需求，以達成業績目標。
* 客戶與市場開發: 積極開發新院所、新醫師及新客戶，拓展業務來源；即時掌握並回饋市場與競爭情報，定期提交相關報告，以支持業務決策。
* 策略執行: 確實執行行銷策略與業務拜訪計畫，辨識並驗證業務機會，與直屬主管密切對齊策略與執行方向，以達成業績及業務目標。
* 敏捷與當責: 在快速變動的環境中展現敏捷、當責與韌性；持續學習並勇於嘗試新的工作方式與通路，依市場變化靈活調整策略與執行方式。
* 合規與專業: 確保所有區域業務活動皆以專業方式執行，並遵循諾和諾德相關政策、合規要求及商業道德準則。
* 商業思維與問題解決: 展現良好的商業敏銳度、創新思維及問題解決能力；以積極主動的態度面對挑戰、掌握機會，持續推動業務成長。
  

**資格經歷**

* 學士以上學歷，藥學、醫藥科學、生命科學或其他相關科系。
* 具 **3** **年以上藥品業務相關經驗**者；若具優異業務成果及扎實醫院市場經驗，亦歡迎具潛力的人才加入。
* 不限特定治療領域；具 **代謝疾病（****Metabolic****）相關產品或市場經驗**者尤佳。
* 具 **區域醫院（****Regional Hospital****）實際市場經營與客戶管理經驗**；具醫學中心（Medical Center）相關經驗者優先考慮。
* 具良好的區域管理、業務規劃及客戶經營能力，並具專業溝通與銷售技巧。
* 具良好的業務成果紀錄，展現高度執行力、當責精神、韌性及成果導向思維。
* 能適應快速變化的市場環境，並具主動開發新客戶、新通路及新業務機會的能力。
* 願意依業務需求於負責區域內進行出差及醫院拜訪。
* 具 **Digital / AI** **工具應用經驗**，並能運用數位工具提升客戶互動或業務效能者尤佳。
* 具藥師執照者尤佳。

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Education Level:Bachelor or higher

Major:

Language:

3. 工程與團隊管理：負責設備叫修維護、指導下屬作業、協調商場人力排班與出勤管理。
  
4. 開發與業主維護：協助營運規劃、績效檢視，並執行商場開發作業與業主、廠商關係維護。

1. 學經歷要求：大學以上畢業，3年以上百貨、購物中心或商場營運管理及團隊領導經驗。
  
2. 核心能力：熟悉商場現場營運、外包廠商管理、財務帳務核對與勞安衛生規範。
  
3. 特質能力：具備跨部門溝通、業主維護、人員排班與突發狀況應變能力。
  
4. 能配合商場排班與管理商場調動（另依管轄商場類型核發津貼 $0~$5,000元）。

jobs.title: Account Manager, Influencer Marketing
jobs.description:
At **Viral Nation,** we specialize in building social-first ecosystems for brands to connect with the modern consumer journey. Our integrated solutions align strategy, talent, media, and technology with culturally relevant creativity to scale the world's fastest-growing digital brands. Viral Nation offers a fluid, creative, and growth-oriented environment that will support your ambitions to apply your talents in an open, collaborative, and fast-paced culture. Our ability to stay at the forefront of the industry has fuelled our success and will guide us in paving the path forward. We're driven to push boundaries and think beyond today to deliver strategies, and we're just getting started.

While we continuously exceed our goals, we need your help – our success is only as great as our people. Strong performance leads to high expectations, and we must keep raising the bar!

The Account Manager plays a pivotal role in the day-to-day execution of client programs, working in partnership with the Client Services teams and our COE (Center of Excellence) to execute social-first marketing strategies built to deliver on client goals. Account Managers are stewards of the VN process and proactively manage the campaign execution. They display exceptional time management and organizational skills and thrive on adaptability, assignments, and tight deadlines. The Account Manager is responsible for successful project delivery and coordinates with junior staff from project initiation to successful campaign execution and delivery.

**Responsibilities:**

* Own day-to-day creator and client communication across assigned workstreams, driving tactical execution and ensuring all deliverables, reporting, and touchpoints are proactive, accurate, and on time
* Support and execute end-to-end influencer marketing campaigns, primarily focused on Micro and Mid-Tier talent, including influencer activation, content/social execution, and community management from kickoff through wrap.
